title: Most important people in his life: Fats, Stuff Smith, Eddie South
summary: Asked who mattered most, he starts with Fats and Stuff Smith, who didn't come any greater, and Eddie South.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom

blocks.x: Who -- what people were the most important people in your life, that you met, that had the greatest effect on you?
Either way, professional, or personal or whatever.
I'm trying to -- I'm just trying to think. I don't --
Would Fats be one of them, or --
Oh heck yes. Definitely. I mean -- I

mean -- well, okay, now I'll start with Fats. Fats, Stuff Smith, the violinist. I think they -- those guys -- well they didn't come any greater. Eddie South was a very fine man. I worked with him too, you know.
